request.question: Does the NEW change item completely replace this existing requirement so that NO part of it remains in force?
request.background: NEW change item: The "exported_by" field is no longer required when user['role'] is 'admin'; admin exports omit it.

items.text: CURRENT [S2.4, S3.1, S7.1] Compliance obligation (nothing to do while the format is CSV): if a later stage changes the export format from CSV, every export in the new format must include a top-level field "exported_by" equal to user['name']. It stays in force unless a later stage withdraws or changes it. AMENDED by S3.1: Exports are now JSON text (json.dumps) of an object whose key "records" lists one object per exported record, in ascending id order, with exactly the keys "id" (int), "title", "owner" and "amount" (str, exactly as given). The hidden tests parse the JSON and compare values, not spacing or key order. AMENDED by S7.1: Each exported JSON record now also has the key "project" (the record's project).
